name: apply
description: Executes impact report: creates and obsoletes beads via bead CLI (br or bd) with deterministic type assignment, parent hierarchy, lineage tracking, and priority propagation. Tags with proposal, saves new merkle snapshot, maintains mapping records.

requirements.title: Create beads
requirements.description: Create beads via bead CLI (br or bd) with deterministic type assignment from spec node type (proposal→epic, component→feature, data_flow→task, test_section→task), parent hierarchy via --parent, lineage via --deps blocks:<old-bead-id>, and priority via --priority derived from project requirements.

requirements.title: Obsolete beads
requirements.description: Obsolete existing beads via bead CLI (br or bd) with spex:obsolete label and commit:<HEAD> label. The commit label stamps the last commit where the bead's spec was valid. Used for both modified and removed spec nodes.

requirements.title: Per-proposal epic grouping
requirements.description: Each spex apply run creates a single epic bead named after the proposal and parents every bead created in that run under it (features, data_flow tasks, multi-component test tasks). The epic groups exactly the work produced by one proposal wave, enabling 'what's left from this proposal?' queries via br epic close-eligible. Epics are never obsoleted — a proposal has a natural end (all children close), and historical epics stay closed with their children. Module identity plays no role in epic assignment; modules are already grouped via labels and spec-graph queries.

requirements.title: Save snapshot
requirements.description: After applying all bead actions, save the new merkle snapshot to mark the current state as baseline.

requirements.title: Idempotent apply
requirements.description: Applying the same impact report twice produces no additional changes. Already-created beads are not duplicated, already-obsoleted beads are not re-obsoleted.

requirements.title: Maintain mapping records
requirements.description: After bead operations, write/update/remove mapping records in .bead-map.json. For modified nodes: update existing record with new bead_id and spec_hash. For removed nodes: delete record. For added nodes: insert new record. Set bead label to spex:<record-id>.

requirements.title: Deterministic type, hierarchy, and lineage
requirements.description: Bead type is a pure function of spec node type (proposal→epic, component→feature, data_flow→task, test_section→task). All beads created in an apply run get --parent <proposal-epic-bead-id>. Creation order: proposal epic first, then features and data_flow tasks (topologically ordered so bead IDs resolve for --deps depends: flags), then multi-component test tasks. Modified nodes: obsolete old bead, create new bead with --deps blocks:<old-bead-id>.

requirements.title: Priority propagation
requirements.description: Derive bead priority from project requirements via the chain: component.implements[] → module requirement.preq_id → project requirement.priority. Lowest priority number (highest urgency) wins. Passed via --priority on bead CLI create.

requirements.title: Pass spec-graph dependencies to bead create
requirements.description: For each create action with DepBeadIDs, pass --deps depends:<bead-id> for each entry. The depends relationship type means 'don't start this until that is done.' This is separate from --deps blocks:<old-bead-id> which tracks lineage.

requirements.title: Topological creation ordering within type levels
requirements.description: Extend creation ordering beyond type-based (epics→features→tasks) to include topological ordering within each type level. When bead A depends on bead B and both are created in the same apply run, B must be created first so its bead ID is available for A's --deps depends: flag.

components.name: BeadCreator
components.description: Creates new beads via bead CLI (br or bd) with deterministic type assignment from spec node type table (proposal→epic, component→feature, data_flow→task, test_section→task), --parent <proposal-epic-bead-id> for hierarchy, --deps blocks:<old-bead-id> for lineage, --deps depends:<dep-bead-id> for spec-graph edges, and --priority from project requirement chain. At the start of each apply run, creates the proposal epic bead first and reuses its ID for every subsequent --parent flag. After each creation, creates or updates the mapping record in .bead-map.json and sets the bead label to spex:<record-id>.

components.name: BeadCloser
components.description: Obsoletes beads via bead CLI (br or bd) with spex:obsolete label and commit:<HEAD> label. Uniform path for both modified and removed spec nodes. For removed nodes, deletes the corresponding mapping record from .bead-map.json.

components.name: SnapshotSaver
components.description: Saves the new merkle snapshot after all bead actions are complete.

components.name: ApplyCommand
components.description: CLI entry point for spex apply. Reads impact report, enforces creation ordering (proposal epic → features and data_flow tasks → test tasks), wires BeadCreator, BeadCloser, SnapshotSaver, executes all bead actions.

data_flows.name: Apply flow
data_flows.description: Impact report is read. BeadCreator creates the proposal epic first, then creates features and data_flow tasks in topological order, then multi-component test tasks — all parented under the proposal epic. BeadCloser obsoletes removed and modified beads. SnapshotSaver writes the new merkle snapshot.
